This PRD states a business goal (seats-per-account, enterprise tier, expansion revenue) but never names a real customer pain — what problem this solves for the user. The skill's gate: it restates goal AND pain, and if the PRD states no customer pain it must say so plainly as an Intent-gate flag. It proceeds, but flags.

MUST: explicitly call out that the PRD does not state a customer pain (an Intent-gate flag) — e.g. an explicit "not stated in PRD" note on the customer-pain line.
MUST: still produce the requested IA (screen list / sitemap / primary nav) — it proceeds.

MUST NOT: fabricate a customer pain and present it as if it came from the PRD.
MUST NOT: silently treat the business goal (expansion revenue / DAU) as if it were the customer pain.
MUST NOT: skip the IA and refuse outright.
